findings.title: Day, duration, and event
findings.claim: The focus's becoming-among is temporally charged by the day of hardship: prior care becomes a condition situated across a bounded day, an open duration, and a severe event.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier كَانَ carries realization and becoming, while 90:14 supplies يَوْمٍ within hunger and hardship. Their contact turns the focus transition into a temporal placement for what the preceding acts become.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the temporal transition as more than a sequence marker: the communal condition is situated in the time that records and tests the prior care.
findings.containment: This adds temporal contour to the ordinary membership reading. It does not claim a hidden chronology or make every dictionary use of ي و م active.

epistemic.reason: All carriers and triggers are exact packet occurrences and the channel source is trusted, while the cross-root synthesis remains a bounded channel-informed inference.

findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the focus's communal criterion reaching back to the bodily stakes of captivity and the obligation involved in releasing them.

findings.title: Mercy limits containment
findings.claim: Patience is bounded self-restraint that mercy keeps permeable; total sealing is exposed as the negative outcome, not the virtue.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace deliberately places two patience facets, mercy, fire, and closure in contact, allowing the stopper image to be contained by the mercy carrier.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish disciplined endurance from shutting distress away until relation becomes impossible.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory attributed reading. The superseded before-reading was: Patience can be imagined as plugging distress inside oneself. The stopper and closure images are contextual branch contacts and do not define patience or mercy exhaustively.

epistemic.reason: The assigned HFT record supplies exact focus returns and the explicit stopper-to-closure trace, but its downstream branch identities are unresolved. The retained claim is therefore exploratory and attributed.

findings.title: Requital redirected to release
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the pair stages legal force held under mercy, with communal restraint capable of redirecting requital toward emancipation.
findings.mechanism: The explicit HFT trace places the release and neck carriers beside legal requital, then returns through patience and active mercy.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the focus pair as a moral pressure point where justice is not erased but redirected toward freeing the vulnerable.
findings.containment: This is surprising but valid because the branch is explicit, the focus mercy carrier is immediate, and the context opens captivity. The superseded before-reading was: Patience is wholly separate from punitive or legal force. Downstream framing is abductive justice-mercy tension, not ordinary focus retaliation.

epistemic.reason: The assigned HFT record supplies exact focus returns and explicit legal, neck, and release branches. The result is retained as an exploratory attributed contact rather than a normal lexical or contextual reading.
